detail.longDescription: Until Claude Code 2.1.309 (Oct 22), sandboxed Bash on macOS and Linux ran the shell's startup files outside the sandbox before each command. Your .zshrc ran with none of the sandbox's limits. The same release stopped sandboxed commands from editing the file passed to --mcp-config. https:// code.claude.com/docs/en/change log Check what version your unattended agents run. To watch one live from a browser, we built https:// shell.online # ClaudeCode # AIAgents # Cybersecurity
